# U142: Correct this check-in replaces it: after posting, the link asks why (under 10 characters is a Must fix), the week keeps one check-in with the new number, History says what it was and why, and Undo puts it back

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `ONE-PER-WEEK`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `IMPORT-UNDO`
- **Budget:** at most 9 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/check-in/ci-docker` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U142

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Rhea's image slimming (ci-docker), due this week: she posts the plan's number, then corrects it.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/check-in/ci-docker` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “This week’s value” field is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Type {right} into the “This week’s value” field.
- Answer every Check question about a number with its yes: the number is meant.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “posted”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The link opens the correction, never a second check-in.
- **Step.** Press the “Correct this check-in” link.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/check-in/ci-docker?correct=1”.
- **Check:** “Why are you changing it?” is shown (else: the correction asks why).
- **Step.** Type {right - 1} into the “This week’s value” field.
- Answer every Check question about a number with its yes: the number is meant.
- **Step.** Type “typo” into the “Why are you changing it?” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in / Continue” button.
- _Note:_ The field's Must fix: the warning mark and the engine's sentence under the field (goal entry 2.1, item 2).
- **Check:** “Say why, in a sentence” is shown (else: a reason under 10 characters is not a Must fix).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `s1.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ci-docker' && c.week === NOW).length === 1`, where `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: something posted with a reason under 10 characters.
- **Step.** Type “I read the dashboard for the wrong week” into the “Why are you changing it?” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in / Continue” button.
- _Note:_ Mode `correct`: the account step may follow; posting goes to the goal.
- If the address doesn’t match “/goals/ci-docker”:
  - If the “Post check-in” button is there:
    - **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ci-docker”.
- **Check:** A status line showing “Week 45 corrected” shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/is now/.test(await toast.innerText())`, where `` const toast = p.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: `Week ${NOW} corrected` }) ``; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the toast said “{worked out in the journey as `(await toast.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`}”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `week.length === 1 && week[0].value === right - 1`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const right = Math.round(planAt(s0.goals.find((g) => g.id === 'ci-docker').plan, NOW))`; `const s2 = await h.snapshot()`; `const week = s2.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ci-docker' && c.week === NOW)`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: week 45 holds {worked out in the journey as `week.map((c) => c.value).join(', ') || 'nothing'`}.
- **Check:** The History section shows.
- **Check:** “Corrected week 45” is shown in the History section (else: History does not say the week was corrected).
- **Check:** “I read the dashboard for the wrong week” is shown in the History section (else: History does not keep why it was corrected).
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “corrected”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Undo takes the correction back: the week holds the number first posted.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button in a status line showing “Week 45 corrected”.
- **Check:** “Undone” is shown.
- _Note:_ Undone, the week's row no longer says it was corrected (review of #225, medium 2): it reads as first posted.
- **Check:** The ci corrected (`.ci-corrected`) in the History section goes away.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `back.length === 1 && back[0].value === right && !stale`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const right = Math.round(planAt(s0.goals.find((g) => g.id === 'ci-docker').plan, NOW))`; `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `const s3 = await h.snapshot()`; `const back = s3.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ci-docker' && c.week === NOW)`; `const stale = await hist.locator('.ci-corrected').first().waitFor({ state: 'detached', timeout: 5000 }).then(() => false, () => true)`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: {worked out in the journey as `stale ? 'after Undo, History still says the week was corrected' : 'after Undo week ${NOW} holds ${back.map((c) => c.value).join(', ') || 'nothing'}'`}.
